qualitative.gate_2_reason: Tabletop fantasy miniatures and wargaming are pure discretionary hobby/entertainment products that are completely deferrable in downturns, failing the essential Western need standard.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). Despite world-class capital efficiency (>100% ROIC, zero debt, >40% operating margins), Games Workshop's Warhammer tabletop wargaming miniatures are pure discretionary hobby products that are completely deferrable and non-essential.
qualitative.evidence: Games Workshop generates extraordinary financial returns (>100% GAAP ROIC, zero long-term debt, >100% FCF conversion) via vertically integrated miniature manufacturing, retail stores, and Warhammer IP licensing. However, end demand is centered entirely on a discretionary tabletop hobby, failing Gate 2's essential Western need or broad entrenched everyday habit criteria.
